summary: The listing calendar write commands (update-prices, update-restrictions, update-inventories) carry their JSON body shape, value types and live-change caution in --help, and `which` resolves natural-language write queries to them.
reason: The spec types these array bodies only as a bare label, so an agent could not build a valid --prices/--restrictions/--inventories value from the CLI alone, and the curated `which` index only knew read-side novel commands, so write queries returned unrelated ops commands. A dogfood resync rewrites the curated index from novel features and drops these entries, so a regen must re-add them.
validated_outcome: TestWhichRanksCalendarWritesFirst fails on the previous index (top match is ops-gaps) and passes after the patch.
